intelligence.task: Current targeted market and specialist craft references. Distinguish observed video/audio from text. No CTR/retention inventions.

idea.task: Rank original ideas against audience, evidence and actual production feasibility; decide internally.
idea.exit: Chosen central question and rejected alternatives with reasons.

story.task: Question, mechanism, complication and payoff; do not compress full story into opening proof.
story.exit: Original beat map and claim-source ledger.

script.task: Narration plus visual progression, editorial choreography and authored sound architecture; actual voice timing.
script.exit: Script and edit/sound blueprint with evidence.

feasibility.task: Representative boards and 4–6-second integrated animal/motion/edit/compositing/audio test. Test hardest relevant problem. No mandatory typography.
feasibility.exit: Actual integrated proof and inspected comparison; not concept image or silent rig.

production.task: Execute binding creative brief. Editing and sound independent core departments. No generic labels or random effects; revise internally.
production.exit: Actual final video, specialist evidence, editable project assets and complete provenance.

qc.task: Actually view and hear output: picture-only, audio-only, combined, reference comparison and technical integrity. No false capabilities.
qc.exit: Actionable defects or specific findings tied to exact video hash.

packaging.task: Promise matches delivered content. Respect brief; no unauthorized public publishing or new trailer.
packaging.exit: Relevant checked deliverables, no misleading promise.

delivery.task: Verify exact reviewed media, upload privately in channel folder, verify object and return link.
delivery.exit: Upload receipt; then await user evaluation, never auto-switch channel.
